title: Trump arrives in Manila for Asean-US special summit, Marcos meeting

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump arrived in Manila on Tuesday afternoon for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-US Special Summit and bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. The Air Force One aircraft carrying Trump landed at the Balagbag Ramp Area (Ages Ramp) at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Pasay City at 5:33 p.m. He was received by Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos, US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton, and Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel “Babe” Romualdez.
